## Line 706

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato, line 706](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato#L706).

```plato

    //==
    // # Transform identity statics
    //
    // The do-nothing transform of every representation in the transform family,
    // gathered in one place so the identity of a rotation, a pose, a TRS transform,
    // a matrix, an affine map, or a projective map is found by the same lookup.

    //==
    // Identity statics — the do-nothing transform of each representation,
    // reachable as `Type.Identity` via the `_: Type` static convention.

    // The zero rotation.
    Identity(_: Rotation2D): Rotation2D
        => Rotation2D(0.0.Angle);
```
